events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Orlando Magic

headlines.description: — Paulo Banchero had 23 points, eight rebounds and eight assists, Desmond Bane added 27 points and Orlando beat the New Orleans Pelicans 128-118 on Sunday in Magic center
headlines.shortLinkText: Magic beat Pelicans 128-118 in Moritz Wagner's return from knee injury

headlines.description: — Cedric Coward hit two late 3-pointers and scored 21 points to help the Memphis Grizzlies hold off the Brooklyn Nets 103-98 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cedric Coward hits 2 late 3s to help the Grizzlies beat the Nets 103-98

headlines.description: — Scottie Barnes hit a tiebreaking free throw with 0.8 seconds remaining in overtime and the Toronto Raptors beat the Philadelphia 76ers 116-115 on Sunday night in the first of back-to-back meetings between short-handed teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scottie Barnes hits tiebreaking free throw in final second of OT as Raptors beat 76ers 116-115

events.name: New York Knicks at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson had 26 points and the New York Knicks snapped the Portland Trail Blazers' five-game winning streak with a 123-114 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks end Trail Blazers' 5-game winning streak with 123-114 victory

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards banked in a go-ahead, 3-foot runner with 16.8 seconds and the Minnesota Timberwolves overcame a 19-point deficit to beat the San Antonio Spurs 104-103 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards banks in late go-ahead runner in Timberwolves' 104-103 comeback victory over Spurs

events.name: Miami Heat at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 29 points after a slow start and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Miami Heat 124-112 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 29 points as Thunder beat Heat 124-112 for 3rd straight win

headlines.description: — Tim Hardaway Jr. scored 25 points, Aaron Gordon had 23 and the injury-ravaged Denver Nuggets beat the Milwaukee Bucks 108-104 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tim Hardaway Jr. scores 25 points, Aaron Gordon adds 23 and Nuggets beat Bucks 108-104

headlines.description: — Royce O'Neale scored 19 points, Devin Booker added 17 and the Phoenix Suns breezed to a 112-93 victory over the Washington Wizards on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suns breeze past Wizards 112-93 for 10th victory in 13 games

events.name: Atlanta Hawks at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 24 points, Jalen Johnson contributed 23 points, 11 rebounds and six assists and the Atlanta Hawks beat the Golden State Warriors 124-111 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alexander-Walker's 24 points lead 6 Hawks in double figures as Atlanta beats Warriors 124-111

headlines.description: — DeMar DeRozan had 22 points and became the 23rd player in NBA history to reach 26,000 points, helping the Sacramento Kings beat the Houston Rockets 111-98 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeMar DeRozan reaches 26,000 career points in Kings' victory over Rockets
